notes.en: Compiler consistency and optimizer release: the borrow checker walks every expression kind and keeps loop borrows live across the back edge, so aliasing such as f($&v, &v) nested in casts or arithmetic is now diagnosed; generics accept any number of type parameters; XU_VERIFY=1 runs the full MIR verifier after every pass; scalar SSA promotion no longer depends on a shape whitelist and ARM64 loop kernels gain SSA-based matchers. See release notes and verified SDK assets.
notes.zh: 编译器一致性与优化器版本：借用检查器遍历全部表达式种类，循环内借用在回边上保持存活，嵌套在类型转换或算术表达式中的 f($&v, &v) 这类别名现在会被诊断；泛型不再限制类型参数个数；XU_VERIFY=1 在每个优化 pass 之后运行完整 MIR 验证器；标量 SSA 提升不再依赖形状白名单，ARM64 循环内核改用基于 SSA 的匹配器。查看发布说明与 SDK 附件。

notes.en: Critical stability and code generation fixes: corrects callee-saved register allocation clobbering in multi-parameter self-recursive functions (enabling safe deep recursion and nested binary expression recursion); eliminates compiler out-of-bounds crash on undefined function symbols with clean diagnostics; passes 8 comprehensive syntax suites and full-matrix regressions across ARM64 and x86-64. See release notes and verified SDK assets.
notes.zh: 关键稳定性与代码生成修复：修复多参数自递归函数在调用处与入口处的非易失寄存器分配覆盖缺陷（支持深度自递归与复杂表达式左/右递归调用）；修复类型检查器在未定义函数符号上的越界崩溃并提供规范诊断；通过 8 套极限语法套件与全矩阵回归验证。查看发布说明与 SDK 附件。
